name: hackintosh-skills
description: 黑苹果（OpenCore）技能集：EFI 配置审查与维护、启动选择器主题。
description_en: Hackintosh (OpenCore) skill collection: EFI configuration audit & maintenance, and boot picker theming.

plugins.name: opencore-config-audit
plugins.description: 审查、修改与维护黑苹果的 OpenCore EFI 配置与驱动安装：BIOS/UEFI 审查、逐键对照官方文档、ACPI/SSDT 巡检、kext 精简、引导日志与启动耗时取证、系统大版本升级（含网卡 kext 的 MinKernel/MaxKernel 版本分流）、磁盘屏蔽，以及 NVIDIA / Intel 无线 / MediaTek / 博通网卡、AppleALC 声卡、HiDPI、Intel 睿频、内存定制、SMBIOS 三码等驱动与硬件特性。
plugins.description_en: Audit, edit and maintain a hackintosh OpenCore EFI configuration and its driver installs: BIOS/UEFI settings audit, per-key verification against the official docs, ACPI/SSDT review, kext trimming, boot-log and boot-timeline forensics, major macOS upgrade planning (including per-Darwin-version kext gating with MinKernel/MaxKernel), disk masking, plus NVIDIA / Intel WiFi / MediaTek / Broadcom cards, AppleALC audio, HiDPI, Intel Turbo Boost, memory injection and SMBIOS/serials.

plugins.name: opencore-picker-theme
plugins.description: 配置、制作与排错 OpenCore 的图形启动选择器（OpenCanopy）主题：图标集、PickerAttributes 属性位、Flavour 系统、标签、位图字体、音频辅助、背景图与 HiDPI。含必需图标清单与尺寸、官方图标集缺哪些可选图标的权威对照，以及 Resources 树合规检查脚本。
plugins.description_en: Configure, build and troubleshoot the OpenCore graphical boot picker (OpenCanopy) theme: icon sets, PickerAttributes, the flavour system, labels, bitmap fonts, audio assist, background image and HiDPI. Includes the mandatory-icon list with dimensions, which optional icons the official icon sets do NOT ship, and a Resources-tree compliance checker.
